'''Norbutal''' was a type of paralytic that was capable of putting individuals to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]].<ref name="Death" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Death Troopers]]'' to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing Virus]] infected the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], causing most of its crew to fall ill and [[Death/Legends|die]], reanimating into [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gorrister]] and twenty-nine others took shelter from the zombies within the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|sentinel-class landing craft]] [[Freebird (Sentinel-class)|''Freebird'']].<ref name="Death" />

Over ten [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], Gorrister's survivors drew lots for who should be given norbutal in a small transdermal patch and sacrificed for the group's survival. The group initially threw the dead bodies from the craft's emergency hatch to keep the zombies satisfied, but it only brought them back for more. Instead, the group ate the remains. When [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Jareth Sartoris]] from the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] took shelter from zombies in the craft. The group&mdash;now only seven [[Gender/Legends|men]]&mdash;attempted to put Sartoris to sleep with norbutal so they could eat him. However, Sartoris killed four members of the group, including Gorrister himself, and escaped.<ref name="Death" />

==Behind the scenes==
Norbutal appeared in [[Joe Schreiber]]'s [[2009]] novel ''[[Death Troopers]]''.<ref name="Death" />
